items.title: When asked by reporters at Media Day in what ways he'll have to adjust to the team, Zubac mentioned "playing up to a touch in PnR" and "already looking ahead when he rebounds the ball."
items.author: Caitlin Cooper
items.body_excerpt:
When asked by reporters at Media Day in what ways he'll have to adjust to the team, Zubac mentioned "playing up to a touch in PnR" and "already looking ahead when he rebounds the ball."

Those were the two skills I picked for him in the video below. This is why you read/watch Basketball, She Wrote:

quote.author: Caitlin Cooper
quote.text:
Hey guys, myself & @samsonfolk.bsky.social previewed the season by picking one micro-skill or macro-concept to watch for every Pacers starter

- pacing
- toggling responsibilities
- FT mechanics
- high(er) wall defense
- rebound landings/outlets

we're back! (for now)
